name: Fog Volume Grid Rendering
definition: A technique to draw FogVolume and FogMaterial nodes into the volumetric fog by adding their density, albedo, and emission to the froxels (volumetric grid cells) that the volume's shape covers, matching Godot 4.6.3's behavior.
summary: Fog Volume Grid Rendering maps arbitrary volume shapes to froxels to solve missing local fog contributions, unlike methods focusing on temporal stability.
